title: Performance benchmark: methanol + ethanol + 1-propanol + water, NRTL, 40 stages
purpose: The named benchmark for the rigorous column's time budget (proposal 0015, W9: components, stages, method, phase mode, tolerances, cold and warm start). A four-component non-ideal column with energy balances, 40 stages, one liquid on every stage (fixture checks.stability). W9 sets the budget and the machine; this case fixes the problem and the accuracy, so a budget is never met by loosening a tolerance or skipping the phase check.
method_choice: docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md rule 3: polar, below 10 bar, with interaction parameters for all six pairs: NRTL with the default sets, ideal-gas vapour.

performance.phase_mode: VL, with the phase-stability check on every stage
runs: cold start (no previous solution), the case's specs
warm start from the cold solution, with warm_specs (reference profile: fixture rigorous_warm)
performance.count: time and iterations both recorded, each run on its own
performance.budget: W9's, stated with the machine; the reference's own time is in the fixture for information only (Python, finite-difference Jacobian, not comparable)

behaviour: matches the reference within the numerical tolerances, cold and warm
no stage splits into two liquids (fixture checks.stability)
expected.branch: The reference's solution, from its stated start.

engine_against_reference.why: Proposal 0015, Engineering basis: flows within 1e-6 relative of the independent MESH solution. Both solve the same equations to residuals of 1e-8 or less, so the difference is the solvers' convergence only.

balances_on_every_stage.why: Proposal 0015: every stage's balances closed to 1e-8. Material: |residual| / F; energy: |residual| / (F x 10 kJ/mol); summation and equilibrium are mole fractions.
